title: GrowthBook SDK picker
description: A pale lavender band split down the middle by a thin rule: heading, paragraph and violet + outline buttons on the left; on the right a white panel with the multicolour rail on its edge, a framework dropdown, an icon-and-name row, a dark rounded code block with lime strings and a copy button, and a mono dotted-underline docs link. Picking a framework swaps the snippet.
notes: the code block forces the dark tokens (class dark) so it stays navy in both modes; quoted strings use chart-4
the dropdown is a native select; the copy button uses the clipboard API
name: growthbook-sdks
